name: VCU Data Management Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, VCU Data Management Ltd is in the business of selling Surveillance products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
VCUDML operates within the electronic industry, focusing exclusively on the manufacturing and distribution of electronic products, with a particular emphasis on Security 
and Surveillance-related equipment. Its business comprises electronic product development and distribution.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.29 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.57% over last 3 years.
